procedural_matters: ITA 51 was represented by Arkadii Kistanov.
ESP 7 was represented by David Terol.
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 7-8 knots of wind and a small chop.
ITA 51 and ESP 7 were sailing on the run just after having left mark 1 astern. ITA 51 was on starboard tack and clear astern of ESP 7, who was also on starboard tack.
ESP 7 gybed to port and was thereafter on a converging course with ITA 51.
ITA 51 sailing deeper and faster, established an overlap to windward of ESP 7 at a lateral distance of 60 cm.
Two seconds later, when the distance between the boats was 10-15 cm, ITA 51 bore away.
No contact occurred between the boats.
conclusions: ESP 7 on port failed to keep clear of ITA 51 on starboard and broke RRS 10.
